summary.en: A struggling artist named Daijiro Manaka is nearly killed by a falling steel beam. While he's lying in the hospital, Detective Takagi and the Detective Boys go through his bag and find his license, a rope, a pair of gloves, and a suicide note. Daijiro wakes up and when Takagi asks him about the bag he claims, it happens that he has an amnesia, but Conan notices he is lying. Daijiro's only living relative is his uncle who has refused to help him unless he gives up on being an artist.
summary.zhHans: 围绕水无怜奈、CIA、FBI和组织行动展开的长期情报战。
